p.b: Public Service and Statutory Authorities Amendment Act 1983

preface.p: BE IT ENACTED by the Queen, and the Senate and the House of Representatives of the Commonwealth of Australia, as follows:

content.p: 1. This Act may be cited as the Public Service and Statutory Authorities Amendment Act 1983.
2. This Act shall come into operation on the day on which it receives the Royal Assent.

part.heading: AMENDMENT OF THE PUBLIC SERVICE ACT

content.p: 3. The Public Service Act 19221 is in this Part referred to as the Principal Act.
4. Sections 32a and 32b of the Principal Act are repealed.

part.heading: AMENDMENT OF THE COMMONWEALTH BANKS ACT

content.p: 5. The Commonwealth Banks Act 19592 is in this Part referred to as the Principal Act.
6. Sections 89a and 89b of the Principal Act are repealed.

part.heading: AMENDMENTS OF THE COMMONWEALTH TEACHING SERVICE ACT

content.p: 7. The Commonwealth Teaching Service Act 19723 is in this Part referred to as the Principal Act.
8. Sections 23a and 23b of the Principal Act are repealed.

section.heading: Settlement of industrial disputes and determination of industrial matters in respect of the Service

content.p: 9. Section 39 of the Principal Act is amended—
(a) by adding at the end of paragraph (2) (a) “or”; and
(b) by omitting paragraph (2) (aa).

part.heading: AMENDMENT OF THE OVERSEAS TELECOMMUNICATIONS ACT

content.p: 10. The Overseas Telecommunications Act 19464 is in this Part referred to as the Principal Act.
11. Sections 33aa and 33ab of the Principal Act are repealed.

part.heading: AMENDMENTS OF THE POSTAL SERVICES ACT

content.p: 12. The Postal Services Act 19755 is in this Part referred to as the Principal Act.
13. Sections 46a and 46b of the Principal Act are repealed.

section.heading: Settlement of industrial disputes and determination of industrial matters in respect of the Service

content.p: 14. Section 70 of the Principal Act is amended—
(a) by adding at the end of paragraph (2) (a) “or”; and
(b) by omitting paragraph (2) (aa).
15. The Telecommunications Act 19756 is in this Part referred to as the Principal Act.
16. Sections 43a and 43b of the Principal Act are repealed.

section.heading: Settlement of industrial disputes and determination of industrial matters in respect of the Service

content.p: 17. Section 67 of the Principal Act is amended—
(a) by adding at the end of paragraph (2) (a) “or”; and
(b) by omitting paragraph (2) (aa).
18. The Superannuation Act 19767 is in this Part referred to as the Principal Act.
19. Section 16a of the Principal Act is repealed and the following section is substituted:
“16a. Where—

(a) section 32a of the Public Service Act 1922 as in force at any time before the commencement of the Public Service and Statutory Authorities Amendment Act 1983 applied in relation to an eligible employee;
(b) a section of another Act that corresponded with the section of the Public Service Act 1922 referred to in paragraph (a) applied in relation to an eligible employee; or

(c) the terms and conditions of employment of an eligible employee have at any time included, or include, provisions that correspond with the provision made by the section of the Public Service Act 1922 referred to in paragraph (a),

this Act applies, and shall be deemed to have applied, to the employee as if any period during which he was or is deprived of salary under and in accordance with that section, or those provisions of his terms and conditions of employment, as the case may be, were a period during which he was on leave of absence without pay.”.

3. No. 13, 1972, as amended. For previous amendments, see No. 98, 1973 (as amended by No. 23, 1976); No. 216, 1973 (as amended by No. 20, 1974); No. 23, 1976; No. 26, 1977; No. 177, 1980; Nos. 5, 61 and 74, 1981; and No. 26, 1982.

7. No. 31, 1976, as amended. For previous amendments, see No. 51, 1976; No. 80, 1977; Nos. 17, 134, 169 and 170, 1978; Nos. 52 and 155, 1979; No. 177, 1980; and No. 92, 1981.
